title: DeployRequest
description: A deploy request for applying schema changes from a development branch to a target branch.

id.description: The unique identifier of the deploy request.

number.description: The deploy request number within the database.

branch.description: The name of the source branch with schema changes.

into_branch.description: The name of the target branch to deploy into.

state.description: The current state of the deploy request.

approved.description: Whether the deploy request has been approved.

deployment.description: Information about the active or completed deployment.

notes.description: Notes or description for the deploy request.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the deploy request was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the deploy request was last updated.

closed_at.description: The timestamp when the deploy request was closed.

html_url.description: The URL to the deploy request in the PlanetScale dashboard.
